resources.name: CP2K (or another open‑source DFT code with COSMO support)

access.notes: Agent may choose any open‑source code implementing the PW91 functional and the COSMO continuum solvation model.

resources.notes: Requires PW91 functional and COSMO implicit solvent (liquid paraffin dielectric constant 2.06).

resources.name: Bulk crystal structures of γ‑Al2O3 (non‑spinel) and AlOOH (orthorhombic)

access.notes: Publicly known; the agent constructs unit cells from standard crystallographic parameters given in the literature (e.g., Table 1 of the paper).

resources.notes: No external download required; structures can be built directly from published atomic coordinates and lattice constants.
